links.reason: நசையில் பெரியதோர் நல்குரவு இல்லை names desire as the worst poverty, and the quatrain shows it at work: காதல் கவற்றும் மனத்தினால் ... ஏதிலவரை இரவு, where asking of oneself would end the want. Line 59 (இரத்தலின் ஊங்கு இளிவரவு இல்லை) supports list_adds.

55 counsels ஞாயிற்றன்ன வெந்திறல் ஆண்மையும் திங்கள் அன்ன தண்பெருஞ் சாயலும்; 59 describes ஞாயிறு அனையை நின் பகைவர்க்கு, திங்கள் அனையை எம்மனோர்க்கே. The same pair is used once as counsel and once as praise, with 59 naming whom each face is turned to. That is a meaningful shared image.
links.text_issue: purananuru:55 has 23 lines against 21 in Duraisamy Pillai's edition.

links.reason: சிறுமை அணியுமாம் தன்னை வியந்து reads pride as a sign of small character; சிற்றில் பிறந்தமை பெருமிதத்தின் அறிப reads the same mark as a sign of small birth. Line 11 (பேரில் பிறந்தமை ஈரத்தின் அறிப) is the matching contrast in the ten, so list_adds holds. The note reports the family reading as the text's own.

முறைசெய்யா மன்னவன் கோற்கீழ்ப் படின் and முறையில் அரசர் நாட்டு meet on the unjust king's land. But the ten's pattern (வறியோன் வள்ளியன் அன்மை பழியார், அறியாத் தேசத்து ஆசாரம் பழியார்) is what people do not blame, so the line more likely excuses one who stays in such a land. The subject's silence is one contested reading, and list_adds turns it into a rule of conduct.
links.text_issue: The construal of இருந்து பழியார் is uncertain.

links.reason: Both are mullai poems of the friend's reassurance: in Kar 9 the flowers speak இன்சொற் பலவும் announcing his return, and in Aka 74 the heroine answers வன்புறை இன்சொல் நன்பல பயிற்றும் நின்வலித்து அமைகுவென் மன்னோ, were it not for the evening குழல். The akam poem limits the reassurance at its own hour, as teaches says.

verses.note: Three இனிது predicates; line 3 to 4 is read as one item, granaries and many true allies, all a ruler's concerns.
Item 2 judges a woman of wandering conduct, which is why it gets a gender norm.
These are ascetic vows (fasting, not bathing) and not a purity rule, so norm is null; the division of line 2 is uncertain.
பண்போல் கிளவியார் is read as women of sweet speech, whom one is not to cling to or tell secrets; that reading is why it gets a gender norm.
The payiram praises the author's work and counts nothing, so it has no items, against Elathi's expected 6 or 5.
The six participles lead to a reward (பழிஇல்லா மன்னனாய்), so the counsel is for anyone and not only the king.
The division of the five paired claims in lines 1 to 3 is uncertain.
The division into five items is uncertain.
The items address king, ascetic and anyone, one each, so the domain is all.
புலால் மயங்கான் states abstention from flesh, and that is why it gets a diet norm.
Only four qualities of the ஆசாரியன் can be separated, fewer than Elathi's expected 6 or 5.
Line 4 sums up the three items and is not a fourth; putting away wives who lack chastity is the reason for the gender norm.
